classification.resume: This record is an administrative file from the Swiss Federal Archives documenting the work of a governmental committee on the protection and revitalization of immovable cultural heritage under the Council of Europe between 1973 and 1975. It contains general information and background materials rather than a direct recording of a debate or event. The file is part of the international organizations holdings.
